title: 貸暗号資産サービス
publisher: コインチェック株式会社
notes: Current first-party product page defines a fixed-term crypto consumption-loan contract and states that Coincheck returns same-quantity/equivalent crypto plus a usage fee at maturity. It expressly says the lending product is not provided as a crypto-asset exchange service, borrowed lending assets are not subject to that framework's segregated-management requirements, the contract is unsecured, the service is not a deposit or deposit-insurance product, and assets may not be returned if Coincheck fails.
